title: Bitcoin Retirement Calculator | Virtuse
description: Bitcoin Retirement Calculator: enter your stack, savings and spending in euros, pick a growth scenario and see year by year if it lasts. Free.
og_title: Bitcoin Retirement Calculator: can your Bitcoin fund your retirement?
h1_q: Can your Bitcoin fund your retirement?
lead: Enter your stack, your monthly savings and what you want to spend. The calculator projects your saving years, then checks year by year whether your Bitcoin covers your spending for life.
noscript: The Retirement Calculator needs JavaScript. You can plan a regular buy with the DCA calculator guide.
s1_p: Your age, when you want to retire, your Bitcoin stack, your monthly savings and your yearly spending in today's euros.
s2_p: Conservative, Base or Optimistic, or your own rate. These are hypothetical scenarios, not forecasts.
s3_p: Your savings buy Bitcoin until you retire. From then on, your spending is withdrawn every year until your life expectancy.
a1: No. Bitcoin's price is volatile and the growth rates are hypothetical scenarios. Past performance doesn't guarantee future results, and Bitcoin can fall in value.
a2: The smallest stack you would need today to retire at your chosen age without saving anything more, under the same growth and inflation assumptions.
a3: No. Selling Bitcoin can be taxable in your country. The Bitcoin tax guides explain the rules for 13 EU countries.
a4: No. The calculator runs in your browser and stores nothing. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds.

rel_tax_p: Rules for selling Bitcoin in 13 EU countries.

disclaimer: For education only. Not financial advice. Projections use constant growth and inflation rates; real Bitcoin returns are volatile and past performance doesn't guarantee future results. Figures are nominal.
